notes.title: Mechanics is a reward for perseverance
notes.content:
[h1]Hard work and patience should be rewarded.[/h1]
Therefore, we have come up with a special mechanic for those who have been trying hard to overcome difficulties for a long time.
Forbidden myths is a challenging game. Each boss is unique and requires a different approach. Therefore, many players may take more than a dozen attempts to kill them. And then the modification of the skill will come to his aid.
[h2]How does it work?[/h2]
When you apply the skill a certain number of times, it will be possible to improve it by choosing a modification at your discretion.
Improvements have 3 stages: bronze, silver and gold. Each stage is a stronger new modification, but it is also more difficult to get it.
The key point is that the progress of obtaining a modification is preserved after death.
Therefore, if you cannot pass the boss for a long time, the game will give you the opportunity to become stronger and make it easier to get a victory.
At the same time, no one forces you to use the modification - if you wish, you can refuse it if you do not want to strengthen the character.

notes.title: Svarog
notes.content:
[h1]The blacksmith God and creator of the earth[/h1]

[h2]Mythology[/h2]
In peacetime, he was portrayed as a blacksmith who works in the Heavenly Forge.
In a state of war – as a Great warrior in red or burgundy armor, in whose hands was a huge sword made of damask steel.
He was valued because of his ability to make tools.

He creates with the help of his hands, and not with words or magic like Veles
He considers people his children. He takes care of them accordingly: he gave them the Sun and fire to cook food and keep warm in the cold.
He taught them how to make cottage cheese and cheese, which were previously considered divine, sacred food.
He made an axe for protection from enemies and a bowl in which the sacred drink was prepared.

According to legend, Svarog found the Alatyr stone, which was magical. After the spell, the stone increased in size and became snow-white hot.
With this stone, the Heavenly God created foam in the ocean, which later became the first land.
Alatyr also had another use – Svarog beat on it with his hammer and new gods and heavenly warriors appeared from the sparks flying around.
On his anvil, Alatyr, he created a plow and a yoke, and dropped them from heaven as a gift for cultivating the land

[h2]Game[/h2]
One of the features of Svarog's development is passive skills. They are well suited for those who do not want to be distracted by extra buttons for applying skills.
Another plus of the passive skills branch is balance, they are equally useful against each boss.
Svarog will allow you to strengthen not only the defense and attack, but also the effectiveness of the shield and counterattack.
At a high level of development, Svarog provides an opportunity for additional recovery of health.
And one of his final skills makes it possible to remove positive effects from the enemy - Koschei the immortal will be very upset)

notes.title: How the main character's armor was created
notes.content:
When creating the armor, we followed the criteria
1. Historicity - the armor should be Slavic.
2. Practicality - armor must fulfill its task, every element of it makes sense.
3. Cost - our main character is not from the rich and could not afford the best armor.
This is how the prototype armor looked like.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/57b2c79fee4177f888f4f5d8f6a71b524b5198d9.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/57b2c79fee4177f888f4f5d8f6a71b524b5198d9.jpg[/img]
The shield in the middle contradicted practicality and it was decided to get rid of it. Instead, they decided to add shoulder protection.
In the end, the result turned out like this, but the problems did not end there.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/cad2690a52de8cbb90cbd282bf7d9e3c4203ebad.jpg[/img]
It turned out that we made a mistake when setting the dimensions and the armor began to fall into the body.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/b11271c9b42e099cb4e00cbc47046bb55ba0fe62.jpg[/img]
Another problem surfaced during animation. Some of the textures were distorted when moving.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/661958d2e2bff7e28d28beb2a729157902762d89.jpg[/img]
Now the result has become much better. Although there are still improvements left
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/051c70e4de5c2a994bfddd3e4b555306ee944b12.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Drawing the forest Famously
notes.content:
[h1]Famously One-eyed[/h1]
Ogre, a character in Slavic mythology. She has disheveled hair, sharp claws and only one eye on her forehead. Famously inhabits the swamp. She has a magical skull that screams for people. When they come close, Famously rushes at them and devours them.

Some sources indicate that famously has an eye on the forehead, but we decided to make an eye on the right side, for three reasons.
1. The eye in the middle strongly resembles a creature from Greek mythology - a Cyclops. We want our creatures to be unique.
2. According to mythology, famously knows how to take other people's forms, but there will always be one eye. Therefore, it famously covers the second half of the face with elements of the image. For example, having turned into a young girl, she will famously cover part of her face with a strand of hair.
This mechanic will be in the game, and in order for it to look logical, the eye must be on one side, otherwise it will move when changing appearance, which is very strange.
3. Symmetry is one of the important properties of the beauty of the face, therefore, removing it, the creature will turn out to be more ugly, as it should be.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/186defd6a7da083154254abd51b56cc41ab3ee9a.jpg[/img]

In the original version, the eye would just be closed. And famously looked more like an ordinary grandmother than a monster. Therefore, we decided to align the left side of the face, removing hints of the presence of an eye, and increase and shift the eye itself. In addition, we changed the skin color and added traces of blood

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/95d648a377f0213e784fab0b5c66475ca2bc2bec.jpg[/img]

After that, we came to the conclusion that we need to somehow highlight the eye. So that it does not merge with the background of the bloody skin.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/c7802b5fd8ec19f1af5e4fa32e3997fe8b7a44c8.jpg[/img]

We will further refine the eye, as well as pay attention to the mouth. We deform the nose more.

[b]Important[/b]: the screenshots are still a raw version of the model. The final result will be much better.
